label: cor-complete-normality-is-hereditary
tail:
VERDICT: CLEAN

BOUNDARY: The statement holds for all subspaces, including empty (if the foundation permits the empty space) and singletons. A subspace of a subspace inherits the subspace topology from the original space, so the transitivity argument in step 1.1 is sound. Boundary and degenerate cases (empty, one-point) satisfy complete normality and T₅ trivially; no counterexample was found.
SOURCES: The full texts of the three cited items were inspected: `thm-completely-normal-iff-hereditarily-normal`, `lem-t0-t1-and-hausdorff-are-hereditary`, and `def-completely-normal-and-perfectly-normal-spaces`. Their statements and definitions correctly support the uses in [L1], [L2], and [F1].
CHECKED: The title, the public Statement, every numbered step (1.1 and 2.1), the Facts & Assumptions, and the Remarks (none present) were read and found to be mathematically accurate and logically valid.
